sourceTitle: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: In the beauty and wellness industry, as in any industry, life skills are considered to be all EXCEPT which of the following?
question.zh: 与任何行业一样，在美容与健康行业中，生活技能包括以下所有内容，但哪一项除外？

choices.zh: 期末考试取得优异成绩

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: Beauty and wellness professionals should study and have a thorough understanding of life skills for all EXCEPT which of the following reasons?
question.zh: 美容与健康专业人员应学习并透彻理解生活技能，原因包括以下所有各项，但哪一项除外？

choices.en: Practicing good life skills will lead to a more satisfying and productive career in beauty and wellness.
choices.zh: 良好的生活技能会带来更令人满意且更有成效的美容与健康职业生涯。

choices.en: They work with many different types of clients, and life skills can help keep interactions positive in any situation.
choices.zh: 他们要与许多不同类型的客户合作，而生活技能有助于在任何情况下保持积极互动。

choices.en: The ability to deal with difficult circumstances comes from having well-developed skills.
choices.zh: 应对困难情况的能力源于充分发展的技能。

choices.en: They are routinely asked to take formal skills and assessment tests and quizzes.
choices.zh: 他们经常被要求参加正式的技能与评估测试和测验。

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.zh: 关于美容与健康行业，以下哪项说法是对的？

choices.en: It is at heart a technical industry.
choices.zh: 它本质上是一个技术行业。

choices.en: It is at heart a scientific industry.
choices.zh: 它本质上是一个科学行业。

choices.en: It is at heart a medical industry.
choices.zh: 它本质上是一个医疗行业。

choices.en: It is at heart a creative industry.
choices.zh: 它本质上是一个创意行业。

question.en: What does a mission statement accomplish?
question.zh: 使命宣言能实现什么？

choices.en: It establishes the purpose and values of an institution.
choices.zh: 确立一个机构的宗旨和价值观。

choices.en: It shows the institution’s compulsion to do things perfectly.
choices.zh: 表明该机构凡事追求完美的强迫倾向。

choices.en: It puts things off until tomorrow or a later date.
choices.zh: 把事情拖到明天或更晚。

choices.en: It shows the institution’s conscious effort to respect others.
choices.zh: 表明该机构有意识地努力尊重他人。

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: An organization’s cultural pulse is often derived from that organization’s _____.
question.zh: 一个组织的文化脉搏通常源自该组织的_____。

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: Once you have finished your company’s mission statement, which of the following have you done?
question.zh: 完成公司的使命宣言后，你完成了以下哪件事？

choices.en: Made your company’s purpose and values public knowledge
choices.zh: 使公司的宗旨和价值观成为公众知晓的信息

choices.en: Ensured you will be full of self-esteem in your career
choices.zh: 确保自己在职业生涯中充满自尊

choices.en: Made certain that your company will adhere to ethical standards
choices.zh: 确保公司遵守道德标准

choices.en: Ensured your company will be successful in its business

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: All EXCEPT which of the following are good examples of mission statements?
question.zh: 以下各项都是使命宣言的良好示例，但哪一项除外？

choices.en: “I am going to make ten million dollars in my first ten years in business.”
choices.zh: “我要在创业后的头十年赚到一千万美元。”

choices.en: “My partnership with her will be one that focuses on fair play and integrity.”
choices.zh: “我与她的合作关系将以公平和诚信为重点。”

choices.en: “We plan to make our business a peaceful and globally responsible organization.”
choices.zh: “我们计划把企业建设成一个和平且具有全球责任感的组织。”

choices.en: “We are dedicated to pursuing a successful career with dignity and an honest approach.”
choices.zh: “我们致力于以有尊严、诚实的方式追求成功的职业生涯。”

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: Which of the following MOST helps an organization to identify long-term and short-term goals?
question.zh: 以下哪项最能帮助组织确定长期和短期目标？

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: Breaking up long-term goals into smaller pieces helps to _____.
question.zh: 把长期目标分解成较小的部分有助于_____。

choices.en: make them seem not so overwhelming
choices.zh: 使其看起来不那么令人不知所措

choices.en: ensure that they are guaranteed to happen

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: All EXCEPT which of the following would be considered short term goals?
question.zh: 以下各项都会被视为短期目标，但哪一项除外？

choices.en: To invest company revenue in next spring’s order
choices.zh: 把公司收入投入明年春季的订单

choices.en: To hire two competent staffers before the busy autumn season
choices.zh: 在繁忙的秋季到来前雇用两名胜任的员工

choices.en: To reach $75,000 in sales by week’s end
choices.zh: 在本周结束前实现75,000美元的销售额

choices.en: To slowly grow the company into broader international markets
choices.zh: 逐步将公司扩展到更广阔的国际市场

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: When you order your daily tasks on your to-do list from most important to least important, what have you just done?
question.zh: 当你把待办事项中的日常任务按重要性从高到低排列时，你刚刚做了什么？

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: You shouldn’t neglect physical activity because _____.
question.zh: 你不应忽视体育活动，因为_____。

choices.en: physical activity is a long-term goal
exercise and recreation are short-term goals
choices.zh: 锻炼和娱乐是短期目标

choices.en: exercise and recreation stimulate clear thinking
choices.zh: 锻炼和娱乐能促进清晰思考

choices.en: physical activity is on your to-do list
choices.zh: 体育活动在你的待办事项清单上

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: When designing a time management system, a beauty and wellness professional should make sure it _____.
question.zh: 设计时间管理系统时，美容与健康专业人员应确保它_____。

choices.en: will work for him or her

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: Once you have become a beauty and wellness professional, you should still never stop learning about your industry because _____.
question.zh: 成为美容与健康专业人员后，你仍不应停止学习本行业的知识，因为_____。

choices.en: the beauty and wellness industry never stops changing
choices.zh: 美容与健康行业不断变化

choices.en: you will always be required to attend classes
formal schooling will always be a part of your career
choices.zh: 正规学校教育将永远是你职业生涯的一部分

choices.en: throughout your career there will be tests and quizzes
choices.zh: 你的整个职业生涯中都会有测试和测验

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: When studying, you may find that mnemonics can be useful as a learning tool because they _____.
question.zh: 学习时，你可能会发现记忆辅助法很有用，因为它们_____。

choices.en: are a short cut to recalling information
choices.zh: 是快速回忆信息的捷径

choices.en: provide a way for you to stay organized
choices.zh: 提供让你保持条理的方法

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: If, when studying for your next exam, you are able to recall the rules of “attentiveness, creativity, and excellence” by remembering “ACE,” which of the following have you employed in your studies?
question.zh: 如果你在准备下一次考试时，通过记住“ACE”来回想“attentiveness、creativity、excellence（专注、创造、卓越）”这三条规则，那么你在学习中使用了以下哪种方法？

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: If a beauty and wellness professional wishes to realize the greatest benefits education can provide, he or she should NOT _____.
question.zh: 如果美容与健康专业人员希望充分获得教育所能带来的最大益处，则不应_____。

choices.zh: 担心每节课都必须出席

choices.en: strive to have flexible goals that easily change
choices.zh: 努力设定容易改变的灵活目标

choices.en: pay such careful attention to their instructor

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: Ethics are BEST defined as _____.
question.zh: 道德的最佳定义是_____。

choices.en: moral principles by which we live and work
choices.zh: 我们生活和工作所遵循的道德原则

choices.en: posted rules and regulations at the workplace
choices.zh: 工作场所张贴的规章制度

choices.en: deep feelings common in all people
choices.zh: 所有人共有的深层感受

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: You will know that someone in your industry has exhibited unethical behavior if they _____.
question.zh: 如果行业中的某个人_____，你就会知道他表现出了不道德行为。

choices.en: conceal information about products in order to sell them
choices.zh: 为了销售产品而隐瞒产品信息

choices.en: price products below competitors to sell more
choices.zh: 把产品定价低于竞争对手以增加销量

choices.en: stay open longer hours to attract more customers
choices.zh: 延长营业时间以吸引更多客户

choices.en: advertise their business aggressively to consumers
choices.zh: 积极向消费者宣传自己的企业

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: Discretion is an important part of ethical behavior because _____.
question.zh: 谨慎保密是道德行为的重要组成部分，因为_____。

choices.en: it is essential that you always take care of yourself first
choices.zh: 始终先照顾好自己至关重要

choices.en: it is not necessary to be truthful with those you do business with
choices.zh: 与生意往来对象没有必要讲实话

choices.en: most clients lie to those they do business with
choices.zh: 大多数客户都会对生意往来对象撒谎

choices.en: you sometimes have to keep certain client information confidential
choices.zh: 有时必须对某些客户信息保密

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: If you always provide skilled and competent service to your salon clients; are honest, courteous, and confidential; keep up with new techniques; and always give accurate information about the treatments and products you offer, you will always _____.
question.zh: 如果你始终为沙龙客户提供娴熟、胜任的服务；诚实、礼貌并严守秘密；持续学习新技术；并始终准确说明所提供的护理和产品，那么你将始终_____。

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: It should be obvious to you who, among your peers, embodies qualities of an ethical person, because they will MOST likely exhibit a strong sense of _____.
question.zh: 在同伴中，谁具备有道德之人的品质应该显而易见，因为此人最可能表现出强烈的_____。

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: Diplomacy is BEST defined by _____.
question.zh: 圆融处事的最佳定义是_____。

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: Practicing diplomacy in your career in beauty and wellness shows that you are _____.
question.zh: 在美容与健康职业生涯中做到圆融处事，表明你_____。

choices.en: motivated and driven to be successful
able to deliver messages in a kind way
choices.zh: 能够以友善的方式传达信息

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: Which one of the following is TRUE?
question.zh: 以下哪项说法是对的？

choices.en: Your personality is the sum of your attitudes and behavioral traits only.
choices.zh: 你的个性仅仅是态度和行为特征的总和。

choices.en: Your personality is the sum of your characteristics, attitudes, and behavioral traits.
choices.zh: 你的个性是个人特质、态度和行为特征的总和。

choices.en: Your personality is the sum of your characteristics and behavioral traits only.
choices.zh: 你的个性仅仅是个人特质和行为特征的总和。

choices.en: Your personality is the sum of your characteristics and attitudes only.
choices.zh: 你的个性仅仅是个人特质和态度的总和。

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: As a professional in the beauty and wellness industry, you should consider yourself to be defined by all EXCEPT which of the following?
question.zh: 作为美容与健康行业的专业人员，你应认为以下各项都能定义你，但哪一项除外？

choices.en: Your ability to be someone other than yourself
choices.zh: 你成为另一个人的能力

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: Which of the following will your clients most likely expect of you?
question.zh: 客户最可能对你有以下哪项期望？

choices.en: To look good and to be well-groomed
To ask a lot of questions and to not be overly confident
choices.zh: 提出很多问题并且不要过于自信

choices.en: To be talkative and to be someone other than yourself
choices.zh: 健谈并表现得不像自己

choices.en: To charge a lot and to be stubborn in pricing

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: Your professional image is _____.
question.zh: 你的职业形象是_____。

choices.en: the impression you project through your appearance and conduct in the workplace
choices.zh: 你通过工作场所中的外表和行为给人留下的印象

choices.en: your ability to control all of the things that clients cannot see
choices.zh: 你控制客户看不见的一切事物的能力

choices.en: your ability to become someone other than who you really are
choices.zh: 你变成一个并非真实自我的人的能力

choices.en: based on your skill and talent, which gets you to the top
choices.zh: 取决于使你达到顶峰的技能和才华

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: If you asked ten different people to define professionalism, you would likely _____.
question.zh: 如果让十个不同的人定义职业素养，你很可能_____。

choices.zh: 得到一个全体一致的意见

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: Which of the following is TRUE of the qualities that demonstrate professionalism?
question.zh: 关于体现职业素养的品质，以下哪项说法是对的？

choices.en: They are made up only of appearance, confidence, and integrity.
choices.zh: 它们只由外表、自信和诚信构成。

choices.en: You will only bring them to certain jobs and only to select clients.
choices.zh: 你只会在某些工作中、面对特定客户时表现这些品质。

choices.en: There is no way to know which qualities these are in yourself.
choices.zh: 你无法知道自己具有哪些此类品质。

choices.en: They will become the template through which you shape your career.
choices.zh: 它们将成为塑造你职业生涯的模板。

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.zh: 对美容与健康专业人员来说，时尚应当是什么？

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: Which rule should the beauty and wellness professional keep in mind when it comes to his or her professional image?
question.zh: 在职业形象方面，美容与健康专业人员应牢记哪条规则？

question.en: Personal grooming includes all EXCEPT which of the following?
question.zh: 个人仪容包括以下所有方面，但哪一项除外？

choices.en: How a person treats coworkers and clients
choices.zh: 一个人如何对待同事和客户

choices.en: How a person cares for parts of their body
choices.zh: 一个人如何护理身体各部位

choices.en: How a person takes care of their hair

question.en: Which of the following is defined as the daily maintenance of cleanliness by practicing good, healthful habits?

question.en: Among the following things that you will deal with as a beauty and wellness professional, which of them is MOST likely to be one of your greatest challenges?
question.zh: 在美容与健康专业人员要应对的以下事项中，哪一项最可能是你最大的挑战之一？

choices.en: The diverse personalities of your clients
The maintenance of your own personal hygiene
The reliance on your own ethics and morals
choices.zh: 依靠自己的伦理和道德

choices.en: The adherence to professionalism in the workplace
choices.zh: 在工作场所遵守职业规范

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: Among the following image enhancers, which one is NOT named in the text?
question.zh: 以下形象提升因素中，哪一项不是正文中提到的？

question.en: A good work ethic depends on all EXCEPT which of the following?
question.zh: 良好的职业道德取决于以下所有方面，但哪一项除外？

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: Which of the following is TRUE of punctuality in the beauty and wellness industry?
question.zh: 关于美容与健康行业中的守时，以下哪项说法是对的？

choices.en: It is at the discretion of the employee.
It is unimportant if all else is in line.
choices.zh: 如果其他方面都没问题，守时并不重要。

choices.en: It is an important part of personal hygiene.
choices.zh: 这是个人卫生的重要组成部分。

question.en: Which of the following should you consider to be your personal calling card, where you display your talents and work for potential employers to evaluate your professional skills?
question.zh: 以下哪一项应被视为你的个人名片，可用来展示才华和作品，供潜在雇主评估你的专业技能？

question.en: There is a saying in marketing today: “If you’re not _____, then you don’t exist.”
question.zh: 当今营销界有一句话：“如果你不_____，你就不存在。”

question.en: What should you think of your portfolio as being?
question.zh: 你应当把作品集看作什么？

choices.en: A story about your education and training for potential clients and employers that allows them to evaluate your professional skills and technical artistry
choices.zh: 向潜在客户和雇主讲述你的教育与培训经历，使其能够评估你的专业技能和技术艺术水平的故事

choices.en: A sample of your personal hygiene for potential clients and employers that allows them to evaluate your professional skills and technical artistry
choices.zh: 向潜在客户和雇主展示个人卫生的样本，使其能够评估你的专业技能和技术艺术水平

choices.en: A presentation of your work ethic for potential clients and employers that allows them to evaluate your professional skills and technical artistry
choices.zh: 向潜在客户和雇主展示职业道德，使其能够评估你的专业技能和技术艺术水平

choices.en: An exhibit of your work on display for potential clients and employers that allows them to evaluate your professional skills and technical artistry
choices.zh: 向潜在客户和雇主展出你的作品，使其能够评估你的专业技能和技术艺术水平

question.zh: 一份有影响力的线上或印刷作品集应包含以下所有内容，但哪一项除外_____。

choices.en: a statement of relevant civic affiliations
choices.zh: 相关公民组织隶属关系的说明

choices.en: a list of personal hygiene and grooming practices
choices.zh: 个人卫生与仪容习惯清单

question.en: All EXCEPT which of the following is true of online communication?
question.zh: 关于线上沟通，以下各项都正确，但哪一项除外？

choices.en: It is a frequent form of communication for those in the beauty industry.
choices.zh: 这是美容行业从业者经常使用的沟通方式。

choices.en: It is a safe form of communication since it requires no etiquette.
choices.zh: 这是安全的沟通方式，因为不需要礼仪。

choices.en: It is a form of communication that can easily be misunderstood.
choices.zh: 这种沟通方式很容易被误解。

choices.en: It has a serious impact on the image-building of your business.

choices.en: GFIs are required wherever direct current is transferred to alternate current (such as in bathrooms).
choices.zh: 凡是直流电转为交流电的地方都必须安装GFI。

choices.zh: 可能存在触电危险的地方（例如流动或积存的水附近）必须安装GFI。

choices.en: GFIs are most useful in spas because appliances that heat up can only operate when a GFI is in place.
choices.zh: 加热电器只有安装GFI才能运行，所以GFI对水疗中心最有用。

choices.en: You should unplug the drill and attempt to repair it before trying to plug it in again.

choices.en: Secure the required credentials from your state’s licensing board by paying a fee.

question.en: The MOST important factor that will influence how well you perform during your state’s licensing exam is _____.

choices.zh: 对课程内容的掌握程度

choices.en: Avoid reviewing your notes too early in the semester.
choices.zh: 避免在学期中过早复习笔记。

choices.en: Avoid cramming the night before an exam.
choices.zh: 避免考试前一晚临时抱佛脚。

choices.en: Get plenty of rest the night before the exam.

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: On the morning of your exam, you should _____.
question.zh: 考试当天早晨，你应当_____。

choices.en: arrive to the test site early
try to get very physically amped up

question.zh: 参加考试时，你应避免_____。

choices.en: making changes to answers without a good reason
choices.zh: 没有充分理由就修改答案

choices.en: skimming the entire test before beginning
choices.zh: 开始答题前快速浏览整份试卷

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.en: GOOD advice to give someone regarding their practical exam would be to _____.

choices.en: take the exact same approach as you did for your written exam

choices.en: never bring the same model with you to the exam on which you practiced
choices.zh: 绝不要带你练习时使用的同一个模特参加考试

question.zh: 如果你计划成为美容专业人员并希望有一天拥有自己的店，首先必须通过规定的州委员会实操考试。备考时，最好的做法是以下哪一项？

choices.en: Avoid practicing on a live model altogether.
choices.zh: 完全避免在真人模特上练习。

choices.en: Practice on as many different models as possible.
choices.zh: 在尽可能多的不同模特上练习。

choices.en: It means you know all of the answers to the test ahead of time.
choices.zh: 你事先知道考试的所有答案。

choices.zh: 你足够自信，完全不需要学习。

choices.zh: 你理解成功应试的策略。

choices.en: It means you crammed in a major study session just before leaving to take the test.
choices.zh: 你在出发考试前刚进行了一次高强度突击学习。

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

choices.en: What do you really want out of a career in the beauty industry?
choices.zh: 你真正希望从美容行业的职业生涯中得到什么？

choices.en: Which clientele do you want to work with?
What fees must be paid and what courses must be taken to get you started?
choices.zh: 开始从业必须缴纳哪些费用、学习哪些课程？

choices.en: What particular areas within the industry are the most interesting to you?
choices.zh: 本行业中哪些具体领域最令你感兴趣？

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

choices.zh: 中等价位的全套服务机构
高端沙龙或日间水疗中心

choices.en: begin your search immediately after graduation
keep the salon or spa’s culture in mind
choices.zh: 考虑沙龙或水疗中心的文化

choices.en: check out websites and social networking sites for various salons or spas
choices.zh: 查看各家沙龙或水疗中心的网站和社交网站

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

question.zh: 决定与沙龙或水疗中心进行初次联系时，应避免_____。

choices.en: sending text messages to the owners before making a phone call or an in-person visit

choices.en: using your best telephone manner when on the phone with the owners
choices.zh: 与业主通话时采用最佳电话礼仪

choices.en: a written summary of a person’s education and work experience

list your skills and accomplishments on it

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

choices.en: Include your first work experiences from long ago.
choices.zh: 包含很久以前的最初工作经历。

寻求专业简历撰写人员的帮助

source.book: Exam Review for Milady Standard Nail Technology, 8th Edition

names and phone numbers of previous employers

wearing fashionable and functional accessories to the interview

choices.en: which skills you feel are your strongest
choices.zh: 你认为自己最强的技能是什么

choices.en: why you want to work there
choices.zh: 你为什么想在这里工作

criticize former employers when given the chance
not sit until you are asked to do so
choices.zh: 在被请坐之前不要坐下

choices.en: Ask: “When will the position be filled?”

choices.en: Ask: “How long do employees typically work here?”
choices.zh: 问：“员工通常在这里工作多久？”

choices.zh: 问：“你们希望找到什么样的造型师？”

choices.en: Say: ‘I don’t have any questions for you at this time.’
choices.zh: 说：“我目前没有任何问题。”

question.zh: 面试后的第二天，你应当_____。

choices.en: send a text asking when you can start
choices.zh: 发短信询问何时可以上班

choices.en: call to see if they’ve made a decision
choices.zh: 打电话询问是否已作出决定

choices.en: follow-up with a thank-you note or email

choices.en: Similar stylish clothing to that of people who work at this spa
choices.zh: 与该水疗中心工作人员风格相近的时尚服装

choices.zh: 美容行业所有雇主都允许员工选择薪酬方式

choices.en: It will allow you to bypass the state board exam and move straight into your career.

choices.zh: 帮助你推销自己并建立忠诚的客户群。

choices.en: It will guarantee you a job with high wages and good working conditions.
choices.zh: 保证你获得一份高薪且工作条件优越的工作。

choices.en: It will automatically translate to a large number of loyal clients.
choices.zh: 自动为你带来大量忠诚客户。

choices.en: you can showcase your skills by working hard and doing your best

question.en: What was the biggest difference between nail technology of the early part of the twentieth century and the later part?
question.zh: 20 世纪前期与后期的美甲技术之间，最大的区别是什么？

choices.en: By the later part of the twentieth century, nail technicians were taking color inspiration from movie stars, whereas in the earlier part of the century, they were not using color at all in nail care.
choices.zh: 到 20 世纪后期，美甲师开始从电影明星身上汲取色彩灵感，而世纪前期的指甲护理完全不使用色彩。

choices.en: Weekly manicures were not something that people did in the earlier part of the twentieth century; however, in the later half of the twentieth century, their popularity skyrocketed.
choices.zh: 20 世纪前期，人们不做每周手部护理；但到了 20 世纪后半期，这项服务的受欢迎程度急剧上升。

choices.en: In the first part of the twentieth century, nail enhancements used things like acrylic, whereas the later part of the century ushered in much more natural nail care.
choices.zh: 20 世纪前期的人工甲增强使用丙烯酸类材料，而世纪后期则开启了自然得多的指甲护理。

choices.en: Nail enhancements such as acrylic tips, intricate nail art, and UV gel became popular in the later part of the twentieth century, whereas technologies and techniques in the earlier part of the twentieth century were more limited.
choices.zh: 丙烯酸甲片、精细指甲彩绘和 UV 凝胶等人工甲增强在 20 世纪后期流行起来，而世纪前期的技术与手法较为有限。

question.en: Which describes the relationship between an ANT and an MNT?
question.zh: 以下哪项最能说明高级美甲师（ANT）与医疗美甲师（MNT）的关系？

choices.en: ANTs and MNTs both must complete advanced coursework; however, ANTs will go on to managerial positions in medical spas, whereas MNTs continue to work directly with clients.
choices.zh: ANT 和 MNT 都必须完成高级课程；但 ANT 会进入医疗水疗中心担任管理职位，而 MNT 继续直接为顾客服务。

choices.en: ANTs and MNTs both must complete advanced coursework and physician-led internships; however, only MNTs can go on to work in a podiatrist’s office.
choices.zh: ANT 和 MNT 都必须完成高级课程和由医生指导的实习；但只有 MNT 可以在足病医生诊所工作。

choices.en: While both ANTs and MNTs are authorized to work in medical settings, only MNTs are permitted to diagnose and treat clients for nail-related issues.
choices.zh: ANT 和 MNT 都获准在医疗环境工作，但只有 MNT 可以诊断并治疗顾客的指甲相关问题。

choices.en: While both ANTs and MNTs are advanced in nature, MNTs complete coursework and an internship under the direction of a physician, whereas ANTs complete one advanced course.
choices.zh: ANT 和 MNT 都属于进阶职业；MNT 要在医生指导下完成课程与实习，而 ANT 完成一门高级课程。

question.en: Which best describes the difference between an independent educator and a manufacturer educator?
question.zh: 以下哪项最能说明独立教育师与制造商教育师之间的区别？

choices.en: An independent educator mostly works with a specific company or product line, whereas a manufacturer educator specializes in the supply chain and manufacturing details behind a particular product.
choices.zh: 独立教育师主要与特定公司或产品线合作，而制造商教育师专门讲授某种产品背后的供应链和制造细节。

choices.en: An independent educator can lead classes and workshops on just about any aspect of the industry that he or she specializes in, whereas a manufacturer educator provides training for a specific product or product line.
choices.zh: 独立教育师可就自己擅长的几乎任何行业主题开设课程和工作坊，而制造商教育师针对特定产品或产品线提供培训。

choices.en: An independent educator and a manufacturer educator differ only in the way that they are paid; an independent educator must invoice for payment, whereas a manufacturer educator is a full-time employee.
choices.zh: 两者只在薪酬方式上不同；独立教育师必须开具发票收款，而制造商教育师是全职雇员。

choices.en: An independent educator is usually a generalist—that is, they have good experience in a variety of topics— whereas a manufacturer educator is highly specialized.
choices.zh: 独立教育师通常是通才，也就是对多种主题都有丰富经验，而制造商教育师则高度专门化。

question.en: Which is TRUE of the difference between dermatitis and eczema?

choices.en: Eczema is not contagious, whereas dermatitis is.

choices.zh: 湿疹是一种炎症性疾病，可引起疼痛性瘙痒，并有急性或慢性之分。

question.en: Your client tells you that they cannot decide between two nail shapes for their upcoming manicure. They ask you what the difference is between oval and almond. What do you tell them?
question.zh: 顾客准备做美甲，却无法在两种甲形之间做决定。顾客问你椭圆形与杏仁形有什么区别，你会如何回答？

choices.en: Almond nails are much narrower and much longer, resembling a long, skinny carrot; oval nails are always short and rounded.
choices.zh: 杏仁形甲更窄、更长，像一根细长的胡萝卜；椭圆形甲总是短而圆。

choices.en: Oval and almond nails are very similar in shape, with the only exception being that almond-shaped nails come to a sharp point, whereas oval nails have a softly rounded point.
choices.zh: 椭圆形与杏仁形非常相似；唯一的区别是杏仁形收成尖端，而椭圆形的尖端柔和圆润。

choices.en: Oval nails are more appropriate for mature clients, whereas almond nails look best on children’s hands.
choices.zh: 椭圆形甲更适合年长顾客，而杏仁形甲在儿童手上最好看。

choices.en: Oval nails are tapered to resemble a long skinny carrot, whereas almond nails come to a point that is squared off.
choices.zh: 椭圆形甲逐渐收窄，像一根细长的胡萝卜；杏仁形甲则收成方形尖端。

choices.en: Stiletto nails and ballerina nails are both long; however, ballerina nails come to a softly rounded point, and stiletto nails are filed off to a very sharp point.
choices.zh: 两种甲形都较长；但芭蕾形的尖端柔和圆润，而细高跟形被磨成非常尖锐的尖端。

choices.en: A ballerina and a stiletto nail could not be more different in shape: a stiletto is long and pointy, whereas a ballerina nail is short, squared off, and does not have much length on the free edge of the nail.
choices.zh: 两种甲形截然不同：细高跟形长而尖；芭蕾形则短且为方形，指甲游离缘几乎没有长度。

choices.en: Ballerina nails are long and come to a very sharp point; stiletto nails have a softly rounded tip.
choices.zh: 芭蕾形甲较长并收成非常尖锐的尖端；细高跟形甲的尖端柔和圆润。

choices.en: While both nails are long and tapered, stiletto nails come to a sharp point, and ballerina nails come to a point that is squared off.
choices.zh: 两种甲形都较长且逐渐收窄，但细高跟形收成尖锐尖端，芭蕾形则收成方形尖端。

choices.en: Thick or thin viscosity resins are quick to cure.

choices.en: Cure time for all resins—thick or thin—tends to be about 48 hours.
choices.zh: 所有树脂无论黏度高低，固化时间通常都约为48小时。

choices.en: They will only cure when coupled with acrylic.

question.en: How has nail art impacted the nail technology industry?

choices.zh: 通过扩大沙龙提供的服务项目，增加了收入。

choices.en: It has increased the amount of parasites that are transmitted from one client to another.
choices.zh: 增加了从一位顾客传播给另一位顾客的寄生虫数量。

choices.en: It has allowed nail technicians to challenge state boards to expand their licenses.
choices.zh: 使美甲师能够向州考试委员会提出扩大执照范围的要求。

choices.en: It has decreased the number of clients a nail technician can see in one day.
choices.zh: 减少了美甲师一天内可接待的顾客数量。

question.en: Which is TRUE of the difference between dermatitis and eczema?
question.zh: 关于皮炎与湿疹的区别，以下哪一项是对的？

choices.en: Eczema appears swollen, red, and hot to the touch, whereas dermatitis appears only as lesions.
choices.zh: 湿疹表现为肿胀、发红且摸起来发热，而皮炎只表现为皮损。

choices.en: There are multiple types of dermatitis, but only one type of eczema.
choices.zh: 皮炎有多种类型，但湿疹只有一种。

choices.en: Eczema is painful and itchy, whereas dermatitis can often appear as a rash-like irritation.
choices.zh: 湿疹疼痛且发痒，而皮炎常表现为皮疹样刺激。

choices.en: Eczema is not contagious, whereas dermatitis is.
choices.zh: 湿疹不传染，而皮炎会传染。

question.en: Which of the following is true?
question.zh: 以下哪一项是正确的？

choices.en: As you press down, the machine speed decreases; as you reduce pressure, the speed increases.
choices.zh: 向下按压时机器速度降低；减小压力时速度提高。

choices.en: As you press down, the machine unlocks; as you reduce pressure, the machine locks.
choices.zh: 向下按压时机器解锁；减小压力时机器锁定。

choices.en: As you press down, the machine locks; as you reduce pressure, the machine unlocks.

question.en: Which is the best reasoning for why a dry manicure must be performed prior to nail tip application?
question.zh: 为什么粘贴甲片前必须进行干式修甲？以下哪项理由最恰当？

choices.en: It is not necessary for a dry manicure to be performed before a nail tip application; it is a special luxury service that can be added on.
choices.zh: 粘贴甲片前不必进行干式修甲；这只是一项可加选的特别奢华服务。

choices.en: If any leftover nail polish is left on the nail, it will show through on the new extension.
choices.zh: 如果甲面留有任何指甲油，都会透过新的延长甲显现出来。

choices.en: The client should be relaxed and enjoy the nail service, and a dry manicure helps to do that.
choices.zh: 顾客应该放松并享受美甲服务，而干式修甲有助于达到这一目的。

choices.en: Whatever is left on the nail will eventually lift, which will cause the tip to lift as well.
choices.zh: 甲面上留下的任何物质最终都会翘起，从而也会使甲片翘起。

question.en: Which describes the relationship between viscosity and curing time when it comes to resins?
question.zh: 就树脂而言，黏度与固化时间之间有什么关系？

choices.en: Thick or thin viscosity resins are quick to cure.
choices.zh: 无论黏度高低，树脂都能快速固化。

choices.en: Cure time for all resins—thick or thin—tends to be about 48 hours.
choices.zh: 所有树脂无论黏度高低，固化时间通常都约为48小时。

choices.en: The thinner the viscosity, the faster cure time; the thicker the viscosity, the longer the cure time.
choices.zh: 黏度越低，固化越快；黏度越高，固化越慢。

choices.en: The thicker the viscosity, the faster the cure time; the thinner the viscosity, the slower the cure time.
choices.zh: 黏度越高，固化越快；黏度越低，固化越慢。

question.zh: 美甲彩绘对美甲行业产生了怎样的影响？

choices.en: It has increased revenues by expanding the service menus offered at salons.
choices.zh: 通过扩大沙龙提供的服务项目，增加了收入。

choices.en: It has increased the amount of parasites that are transmitted from one client to another.
choices.zh: 增加了从一位顾客传播给另一位顾客的寄生虫数量。

choices.en: It has allowed nail technicians to challenge state boards to expand their licenses.
choices.zh: 使美甲师能够向州考试委员会提出扩大执照范围的要求。

choices.en: It has decreased the number of clients a nail technician can see in one day.
choices.zh: 减少了美甲师一天内可接待的顾客数量。
